source: Portrait Atlas P07, eight rows A-H by five columns 1-5

A1.look: wisps of pale hair, wide blue eyes, mouth open on a sound that has not arrived

A2.look: dark skin, black curls, laughing with her whole face

A3.look: soft brown hair, enormous dark eyes, wrapped in green and set down in a basket

A4.look: fair and pink, thin blond hair, brows drawn together over something

A5.look: black hair, two front teeth missing, grinning about it

B1.look: dark skin, cropped hair, a green tunic and a smile that is up to something

B2.look: a mass of red curls, blue eyes, caught in the middle of being amazed

B3.look: olive skin, dark hair pulled back hard, a gold dress and a level, unimpressed look

B4.look: straw-blond, freckled, gap-toothed, laughing at nothing in particular

B5.look: dark skin, hair in tight braids, purple tunic, deciding whether to trust you

C1.look: dark hair and darker eyes, a green tunic, the picture of an injustice endured

C2.look: brown hair under a white cap, blue eyes, a smile with nothing behind it but goodwill

C3.look: shaggy fair hair, a grey hood, standing by a horse and wishing he were elsewhere

C4.look: dark skin, black curls, laughing so hard his eyes have shut

C5.look: dark wavy hair, a worm held up for inspection, delighted and slightly appalled

D1.look: light brown hair cut blunt at the jaw, freckles, looking straight at you

D2.look: dark skin, hair shorn close, a gold tunic, entirely serious about everything

D3.look: dark braids under a blue hood, a mole on one cheek, plainly planning something

D4.look: dark hair, a red tunic, holding up a bowl as though he had made it himself

D5.look: blond curls, blue eyes, bundled in a pale scarf and looking at everything at once

E1.look: dark curls, olive skin, a leather jerkin, thinking about something he will not say

E2.look: dark hair in two braids, cows behind her, unbothered by any of it

E3.look: red hair, freckles, juice on his chin, standing under a tree he has been robbing

E4.look: dark skin, black curls, a basket on his arm and a smile the width of his face

E5.look: sandy hair, a split lip, a purple tunic and the grin of someone who started it

F1.look: a white cloth over her hair, laughing out loud, a mauve tunic

F2.look: brown curls, very round blue eyes, at the age where everything is new

F3.look: brown hair tied back, autumn trees behind, worried about something she has not said

F4.look: dark skin, black curls, a green tunic, the friendliest face on the lane

F5.look: black hair cut straight, holding two cherries by the stem like a prize

G1.look: brown hair, a rust tunic, a scowl he has been working on all morning

G2.look: dark braids, holding a hedgehog against her chest, entirely content

G3.look: dark skin, head shaved close, standing in the wheat and grinning at the sun

G4.look: blonde hair pinned up, freckles across the nose, laughing with her eyes shut

G5.look: reddish curls, a green tunic, a smirk that says he knows what you did

H1.look: dark curls under a cloth, olive skin, a steady look that does not move first

H2.look: shaggy fair hair, head back, laughing at something that was not that funny

H3.look: dark skin, braided hair, holding folded cloth, carrying it like a duty

H4.look: black hair, dark eyes, a grey tunic, meeting your eye and saying nothing

H5.look: red hair, freckles, a grasshopper on her shoulder and no intention of moving
